title: Complex Fuchsian rigidity of ball quotients with critical exponent two and a compact positive-dimensional analytic subset
author: William Sarem
work: Holomorphic functions on geometrically finite quotients of the ball
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 13 (2026), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.328
difficulty_reason: The prior existence and contraction formulas for the natural flow do not themselves force a quotient containing a compact analytic set to preserve a complex geodesic. The authored proof uses calibrated volume minimality to rule out strict contraction, turns trace equality on every limit-set direction into a single complex tangent line, and then localizes the analytic set in the invariant geodesic quotient. Showing that this quotient must be compact supplies the global rigidity obligation beyond the precise prior flow and comparison foundations.
